description.sl: Ovčar Florian nima avta in pozna vse povezave: javni promet in podnebna vozovnica, vozači in skupne vožnje, električni avtomobili in polnilnice, kolesarska pot ob Zilji, zamujene zveze, poštni avtobus, popusti, nadomestni prevoz, obvozi in zapore, obvestila na postaji in območje souporabe na glavnem trgu. Avstrijsko: die Öffis, versäumen, die Begegnungszone.
description.en: Florian the shepherd has no car and knows every connection: public transport and the Klimaticket, commuters and car pools, electric cars and charging points, the cycle path along the Gail, missed connections, the regional bus, reductions, replacement buses, diversions, closures and the shared space on the main square. Austrian: die Öffis, versäumen, die Begegnungszone.
description.it: Florian, il pastore, non ha la macchina e conosce ogni collegamento: i mezzi pubblici e il Klimaticket, pendolari e car pooling, auto elettriche e colonnine, la ciclabile lungo il Gail, le coincidenze perse, l'autobus regionale, le riduzioni, il servizio sostitutivo, deviazioni, chiusure e la zona d'incontro in piazza. In austriaco: die Öffis, versäumen, die Begegnungszone.

review: de, sl, en, it: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker
